non_functional.note: First-cut ICS for the CNF comparison re-base (#232), derived from the EHRbase 2.x documented surface: ADL 1.4 OPT provisioning only (no ADL 2 endpoints), no demographic/messaging/EHR-extract services, Basic auth with one clinical + one admin principal (no readonly role — the ixit declares no readonly instance), SimplifiedFormats UNCLAIMED: measured 2026-07-22, the /openehr/v1 composition endpoint answers 415 to the ITS-REST 1.1.0 media types (application/openehr.wt.flat+json / wt.structured+json) and accepts only the deprecated .schema+json names — the ITS-REST simplified wire is not implemented. Option selection (directory-empty-error) is configuration-pinned by docker/sut-ehrbase.yml, as is SYSTEM_ALLOWTEMPLATEOVERWRITE=false — no longer an option selection since the 2026-07-28 re-adjudication of AMB-4 made the duplicate-template 409 a gating expectation for every server, but still the setting this SUT needs in order to meet it. The canonical-XML family options (AMB-167) carry forward the posture this ICS already implied before those rows became option-gated — the EHR / EHR_STATUS / directory XML rows were judged as served and the CONTRIBUTION read rows as refused — with no new claim made; the party family is not declared because PartyOperations is not claimed. served_extensions is empty because this ICS declares no route family beyond the openEHR resource set for this SUT: the extension families the catalogue carries are another product's own design, and this statement neither publishes them nor asserts that EHRbase serves nothing outside the openEHR resources — an undeclared surface is simply not declared here. Every claim is refined by the measured run — the published verdicts, not this file, are the record.
